standard_prerequisites.name: Profiles of matchings in the hypercube Q^n and admissibility
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a matching M in the cube Q^n the profile is the vector x in N^n whose i-th coordinate counts the edges of M whose endpoints differ in the i-th coordinate; a tuple is admissible when it is the profile of some matching, a tuple is even when every coordinate is even, and it is perfect when the sum of its coordinates equals 2^{n-1}; the article's own definitions are retained at source line 51.
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the meaning of admissible, which is exactly the conclusion of the counted theorem for every tuple of norm below 2^{n-1}.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Balister-Gyori-Schelp partitioning problem and its vanishing-sum condition
standard_prerequisites.statement: Given elements d_1, ..., d_{2^{n-1}} of the vector space over F_2 of dimension n, if the cube is partitioned into pairs with those differences then the sum of all d_i must vanish; the article records this identity at source lines 30-33 and the conjecture that the condition is also sufficient at source lines 34-36.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof of the counted theorem invokes the conjecture for sequences all of whose differences have Hamming weight one, so both the statement and the surrounding setting must be available.

standard_prerequisites.name: Hall's theorem on abelian groups and the batch-code argument of Hollmann, Khathuria, Riet and Skachek
standard_prerequisites.statement: The proof uses that a result of Hall implies the Balister-Gyori-Schelp conjecture for sequences in which every difference has odd Hamming weight, as recorded by Hollmann, Khathuria, Riet and Skachek in the remark cited by the author; the two bibliography entries are retained verbatim with this card.
standard_prerequisites.use: This is the external fact that the author invokes at the opening of his proof; the counted unit is the derivation of the norm-below-threshold statement from it, not the fact itself.

core_obligations: Record the external fact invoked at the start of the proof: by arguments of Hollmann, Khathuria, Riet and Skachek together with a result of Hall, the Balister-Gyori-Schelp conjecture holds whenever all the vectors d_1, ..., d_{2^{n-1}} have odd Hamming weight (source line 296).

Reduce to the critical norm: it suffices to prove the statement for tuples x in N^n with norm exactly 2^{n-1} minus one, since a tuple of smaller norm is dominated coordinatewise by such a tuple and admissibility is inherited by dominated tuples (source line 298).

Construct the sequence of differences: for such a tuple x take x_j copies of the unit vector e_j for each j in [n] together with the single further vector d_{2^{n-1}} equal to the sum of the previous ones (source line 298).

Check the odd-weight hypothesis: each of the first 2^{n-1} minus one vectors has Hamming weight one, so the additional vector, being their sum over F_2, has odd Hamming weight as well, whence every difference in the sequence has odd Hamming weight (source line 298).

Apply the external fact to obtain a partition of F_2^n into pairs {a_i, b_i} with a_i minus b_i equal to d_i for every i, and read off the matching M consisting of the pairs indexed by the first 2^{n-1} minus one indices, whose profile is the given tuple x (source lines 298-299).
Conclude that x is admissible, which completes the proof of the counted theorem (source line 300).

proof_roadmap.step: Quote the odd-Hamming-weight case of the Balister-Gyori-Schelp conjecture, attributed to Hollmann-Khathuria-Riet-Skachek and Hall.
Reduce to tuples of norm exactly 2^{n-1} minus one and build the difference sequence from unit vectors plus their sum.
Verify that all differences have odd Hamming weight so that the quoted case applies.
Turn the resulting partition of the cube into a matching with profile x and conclude admissibility.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2404.03950v3 的 Theorem c:admissible（源 292-294 行，证明 295-300 行）：对任意 n 与任意范数小于 2^{n-1} 的元组 x 属于 N^n 证明 x 是可容许的（即某个匹配的 profile）。证明的关键不是例行核验：必须把一般元组化归到范数恰为 2^{n-1}-1 的临界情形（因为可容许性对逐坐标支配封闭，298 行），再构造一串差向量——把 x_j 个单位向量 e_j 与「前 2^{n-1}-1 个之和」这最后一个向量放在一起，并验证每个差向量的 Hamming 重量都是奇数（单位向量重量为 1，而它们的 F_2 和重量为奇数），才能套用作者引用的「奇重量情形」结论得到 F_2^n 的一个配对分解（296、298 行）；最后由配对分解读出 profile 恰为 x 的匹配（299-300 行）。难点在于把「范数上界」与「奇重量」两个条件同时对齐，并让最后一个差向量承担补齐奇偶性的角色；原文位置在证明的 296 行与 298 行。
